held_measurements.source: MOESM3 Supplementary Figure 14a row 4; Figure 3a row 4
held_measurements.reason: Named N cohort duplicates the 10-min values but main prose says 5 min. Retain explicitly timed series; no unique named-cohort duration inferred.

Main text calls 5 min highest strength and conductivity; S3 data show 2 min highest treated strength and 10 min highest conductivity. Named N cohort means match 10 min; do not silently reassign its method.
Main final specific strength 1.26 +/-0.07 N/tex versus Table8/9 and workbook 1.29 +/-0.08 using density-gradient normalization. Keep bases distinct.
Table9 c/d density footnotes are reversed relative to row names and Methods; e names area density but numbers use density-gradient values.
Table9 MoCl5 linear-specific conductivity 8235 differs from source workbook mean 8325.34 S m2/kg; unresolved source conflict.
Table9 final linear-specific conductivity 13746 differs slightly from source workbook 13748.39. Direct recomputation with mean tex is retained separately.
Reported specific-conductivity SDs vary resistance at fixed group area/density/tex; they are not full propagated uncertainties of all measured quantities.

QA correction: original source workbook 41467_2026_69498_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx, Supplementary Figure 13a!B4:C4, reports 25.97 +/- 0.09 MS/m, agreeing with main article.pdf p.5. The earlier QA claim that the workbook SD was 0.06 MS/m was incorrect; direct cell and worksheet-XML inspection confirm 0.09 MS/m. Retain SD 0.09 MS/m; no unresolved primary-source uncertainty conflict is established for this entry.
Table 9 normalization variants and additional headline properties not added in this packet; no thermal conductivity or film Hall values assigned to fibers.
